scenario: [LNLS.3.3] / [LNLS.3.3c] — one anchored pair is not enough in a rule of three patterns: `x` is anchored to `d`, and `z` compares only `z.ceiling > x.amount`, so `z` joins by scan. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_3_3_anchors` judges EVERY positive pattern after the first; a check that stopped at the first anchored pair would compile this.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Device scope logical:
    device_id: String key

schema Reading scope logical:
    device_id: String key
    amount: Int mutable

schema Limit scope logical:
    device_id: String key
    ceiling: Int mutable

rule joined:
    Device d
    Reading x where x.device_id == d.device_id
    Limit z where z.ceiling > x.amount
->
    log info "x"
